messages:
anya: Quick sync on quicklinks in the console docs panel. Sketch is in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/quicklinks. Main debate: should quicklinks show inline descriptions under the link (one-liners) or just a short label to keep the panel compact?
devin: Leaning compact labels. Placing text under every link makes the panel too tall on smaller screens. We can show descriptions on hover / focus instead.
anya: Hover descriptions sound good but remember keyboard-only users. If we do hover, we must expose the same info via focus and an aria-describedby id.
sam: Agreed. Also suggest an option: expand/collapse chevrons for sections so power users can reveal descriptions for a group. Default collapsed.
devin: Nice. UX nit: if we add expand, ensure the chevron is 44px touch target. Also add aria-controls and aria-expanded.
anya: Copy question: labels currently use verbs like "Learn batching" vs nouns like "Batching". Which is clearer?
sam: Use nouns for navigation items ("Batching") and reserve verbs for CTAs. "Open batching guide" could be a CTA inside the panel.
devin: For analytics, prefer adding a query param source=quicklinks rather than stuffing into the hash. So `/docs/console?src=quicklinks#batching`. Keeps anchors stable.
anya: Okay, consensus: compact labels, optional per-section expand for descriptions, hover/focus shows description, keyboard accessibility via aria-describedby, verbs only inside CTAs. Telemetry uses src=quicklinks param.
docs-bot: FYI: docs team adding short-summary frontmatter for headings to support quicklink snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/370.
sam: One more accessibility ask: visible focus indicator for each link and an offscreen status for dynamic description updates (aria-live="polite").
anya: Good call. I'll update the Figma and open a ticket with acceptance criteria (keyboard nav, aria-describedby, aria-live, telemetry param). Thanks :thumbsup:
summary: Decision thread about console docs quicklinks: choose compact labels with optional per-section expanders, show descriptions on hover/focus with aria-describedby and aria-live for screen readers, use nouns for labels and verbs for CTAs, add telemetry via ?src=quicklinks, ensure touch target and ARIA attributes. Mentions docs PR for short-summary frontmatter.
